relations.name: reporting_partner_capital_ledger_v1
relations.view_definition:
WITH dated AS (
         SELECT reporting_partner_capital_v1.partner_id,
            reporting_partner_capital_v1.activity_date,
            sum(reporting_partner_capital_v1.net_movement) AS movement
           FROM reporting_partner_capital_v1
          WHERE reporting_partner_capital_v1.activity_date IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY reporting_partner_capital_v1.partner_id, reporting_partner_capital_v1.activity_date
        ), balances AS (
         SELECT dated.partner_id,
            dated.activity_date,
            sum(dated.movement) OVER (PARTITION BY dated.partner_id ORDER BY dated.activity_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS date_end_capital
           FROM dated
        )
 SELECT c.capital_id,
    c.partner_id,
    c.partner_name,
    c.partner_role,
    c.activity_date,
    c.transaction_type,
    c.amount,
    c.net_movement,
    c.valid,
    b.date_end_capital
   FROM reporting_partner_capital_v1 c
     LEFT JOIN balances b USING (partner_id, activity_date);

relations.name: reporting_partner_capital_v1
relations.view_definition:
SELECT c."Row ID" AS capital_id,
    c."Ref Partner" AS partner_id,
    p."Partner Name" AS partner_name,
    p."Partner Role" AS partner_role,
    c."Contribution Date" AS activity_date,
    c."Transaction Type" AS transaction_type,
    c."Amount"::numeric AS amount,
        CASE
            WHEN c."Transaction Type" = 'Contribution'::text THEN c."Amount"::numeric
            ELSE - c."Amount"::numeric
        END AS net_movement,
    ((p."Partner Role" = ANY (ARRAY['A'::text, 'B'::text])) AND c."Amount" IS NOT NULL AND c."Contribution Date" IS NOT NULL AND (c."Transaction Type" = ANY (ARRAY['Contribution'::text, 'Withdrawal'::text]))) IS TRUE AS valid
   FROM "Cash Pool Contributions" c
     LEFT JOIN "Partners" p ON p."Row ID" = c."Ref Partner";

relations.name: reporting_partner_daily_v1
relations.comment: R044 actual daily allocated earnings, expenses, completed transfer-date payouts and capital. Historical allocations and opening capital precede display filters. Current records restate history; no forecasts or historic pending reconstruction.
relations.view_definition:
WITH bounds AS (
         SELECT LEAST(COALESCE(min(x.d), olap_reporting_date()), olap_reporting_date()) AS starts
           FROM ( SELECT reporting_partner_capital_v1.activity_date AS d
                   FROM reporting_partner_capital_v1
                UNION ALL
                 SELECT reporting_partner_earnings_v1.activity_date
                   FROM reporting_partner_earnings_v1
                UNION ALL
                 SELECT reporting_partner_settlements_v1.activity_date
                   FROM reporting_partner_settlements_v1) x
        ), dates AS (
         SELECT generate_series(bounds.starts::timestamp with time zone, olap_reporting_date()::timestamp with time zone, '1 day'::interval)::date AS activity_date
           FROM bounds
        ), capital AS (
         SELECT reporting_partner_capital_v1.partner_id,
            reporting_partner_capital_v1.activity_date,
            sum(reporting_partner_capital_v1.amount) FILTER (WHERE reporting_partner_capital_v1.transaction_type = 'Contribution'::text) AS contributed,
            sum(reporting_partner_capital_v1.amount) FILTER (WHERE reporting_partner_capital_v1.transaction_type = 'Withdrawal'::text) AS withdrawn,
            sum(reporting_partner_capital_v1.net_movement) AS movement
           FROM reporting_partner_capital_v1
          GROUP BY reporting_partner_capital_v1.partner_id, reporting_partner_capital_v1.activity_date
        ), earnings AS (
         SELECT reporting_partner_earnings_v1.partner_id,
            reporting_partner_earnings_v1.activity_date,
            sum(reporting_partner_earnings_v1.allocated_interest) AS interest,
            sum(reporting_partner_earnings_v1.allocated_expense) AS expense
           FROM reporting_partner_earnings_v1
          GROUP BY reporting_partner_earnings_v1.partner_id, reporting_partner_earnings_v1.activity_date
        ), settled AS (
         SELECT reporting_partner_settlements_v1.partner_id,
            reporting_partner_settlements_v1.activity_date,
            sum(reporting_partner_settlements_v1.completed_amount) AS completed
           FROM reporting_partner_settlements_v1
          GROUP BY reporting_partner_settlements_v1.partner_id, reporting_partner_settlements_v1.activity_date
        ), daily AS (
         SELECT p.partner_id,
            p.partner_name,
            d_1.activity_date,
            p.ready,
            p.capital_exceptions,
            p.earnings_exceptions,
            p.settlement_exceptions,
                CASE
                    WHEN p.capital_exceptions = 0 AND p.earnings_exceptions = 0 AND p.role_count = 1 THEN COALESCE(e.interest, 0::numeric)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS allocated_interest,
                CASE
                    WHEN p.capital_exceptions = 0 AND p.earnings_exceptions = 0 AND p.role_count = 1 THEN COALESCE(e.expense, 0::numeric)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS allocated_expense,
                CASE
                    WHEN p.settlement_exceptions = 0 THEN COALESCE(s.completed, 0::numeric)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS completed_payouts,
                CASE
                    WHEN p.capital_exceptions = 0 THEN COALESCE(c.contributed, 0::numeric)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS capital_contributed,
                CASE
                    WHEN p.capital_exceptions = 0 THEN COALESCE(c.withdrawn, 0::numeric)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS capital_withdrawn,
                CASE
                    WHEN p.capital_exceptions = 0 THEN COALESCE(c.movement, 0::numeric)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS capital_movement
           FROM reporting_partner_position_v1 p
             CROSS JOIN dates d_1
             LEFT JOIN capital c USING (partner_id, activity_date)
             LEFT JOIN earnings e USING (partner_id, activity_date)
             LEFT JOIN settled s USING (partner_id, activity_date)
        )
 SELECT partner_id,
    partner_name,
    activity_date,
    ready,
    capital_exceptions,
    earnings_exceptions,
    settlement_exceptions,
    allocated_interest,
    allocated_expense,
    completed_payouts,
    capital_contributed,
    capital_withdrawn,
    capital_movement,
    allocated_interest - allocated_expense AS net_earned,
        CASE
            WHEN capital_exceptions = 0 THEN sum(capital_movement) OVER (PARTITION BY partner_id ORDER BY activity_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS capital_eod
   FROM daily d;

relations.name: reporting_partner_earnings_v1
relations.view_definition:
WITH mapping AS (
         SELECT "Partners"."Partner Role" AS role,
            min("Partners"."Row ID") AS partner_id
           FROM "Partners"
          WHERE "Partners"."Partner Role" = ANY (ARRAY['A'::text, 'B'::text])
          GROUP BY "Partners"."Partner Role"
         HAVING count(*) = 1
        ), events AS (
         SELECT 'Interest'::text AS event_type,
            r."Row ID" AS event_id,
            r."Payment Date" AS activity_date,
            v.role,
            v.amount AS allocated_interest,
            0::numeric AS allocated_expense,
            r."Interest Paid" IS NOT NULL AS amount_known
           FROM olap_repayments_analytics r
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( VALUES ('A'::text,r."Partner A Profit"), ('B'::text,r."Partner B Profit")) v(role, amount)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'Expense'::text,
            e_1."Row ID",
            e_1."Expense Date",
            v.role,
            0::numeric AS "numeric",
            v.amount,
            e_1."Amount" IS NOT NULL
           FROM "Business Expenses" e_1
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( VALUES ('A'::text,e_1."Partner A Expense"::numeric), ('B'::text,e_1."Partner B Expense"::numeric)) v(role, amount)
        )
 SELECT e.event_type,
    e.event_id,
    e.activity_date,
    e.role,
    e.allocated_interest,
    e.allocated_expense,
    e.amount_known,
    m.partner_id,
    p."Partner Name" AS partner_name,
    e.allocated_interest - e.allocated_expense AS net_earned,
    m.partner_id IS NOT NULL AND e.activity_date IS NOT NULL AND e.amount_known AND e.allocated_interest IS NOT NULL AND e.allocated_expense IS NOT NULL AS valid
   FROM events e
     LEFT JOIN mapping m ON m.role = e.role
     LEFT JOIN "Partners" p ON p."Row ID" = m.partner_id;

relations.name: reporting_partner_position_v1
relations.comment: R044 current all-record partner entitlement. Net earned less all non-Cancelled reservations. Nullable safe availability, full-pool denominator, role uniqueness and global data-quality checks. Not cash liquidity.
relations.view_definition:
WITH partners AS (
         SELECT "Partners"."Row ID" AS partner_id,
            "Partners"."Partner Name" AS partner_name,
            "Partners"."Partner Role" AS partner_role,
            count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "Partners"."Partner Role") AS role_count
           FROM "Partners"
          WHERE "Partners"."Partner Role" = ANY (ARRAY['A'::text, 'B'::text])
        ), capital AS (
         SELECT reporting_partner_capital_v1.partner_id,
            sum(reporting_partner_capital_v1.net_movement) AS net_capital,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT reporting_partner_capital_v1.valid) AS invalid_count
           FROM reporting_partner_capital_v1
          GROUP BY reporting_partner_capital_v1.partner_id
        ), earnings AS (
         SELECT reporting_partner_earnings_v1.partner_id,
            sum(reporting_partner_earnings_v1.allocated_interest) AS interest_earned,
            sum(reporting_partner_earnings_v1.allocated_expense) AS expenses,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT reporting_partner_earnings_v1.valid OR reporting_partner_earnings_v1.activity_date > olap_reporting_date()) AS invalid_count
           FROM reporting_partner_earnings_v1
          GROUP BY reporting_partner_earnings_v1.partner_id
        ), settlements AS (
         SELECT reporting_partner_settlements_v1.partner_id,
            sum(reporting_partner_settlements_v1.completed_amount) AS completed,
            sum(reporting_partner_settlements_v1.pending_amount) AS pending,
            sum(reporting_partner_settlements_v1.reserved_amount) AS reserved,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE reporting_partner_settlements_v1.status = 'Pending'::text) AS pending_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT reporting_partner_settlements_v1.valid OR reporting_partner_settlements_v1.status = 'Completed'::text AND (reporting_partner_settlements_v1.activity_date IS NULL OR reporting_partner_settlements_v1.activity_date > olap_reporting_date())) AS invalid_count
           FROM reporting_partner_settlements_v1
          GROUP BY reporting_partner_settlements_v1.partner_id
        ), quality AS (
         SELECT ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM reporting_partner_capital_v1
                  WHERE NOT reporting_partner_capital_v1.valid OR reporting_partner_capital_v1.activity_date > olap_reporting_date()) AS capital_exceptions,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM reporting_partner_earnings_v1
                  WHERE NOT reporting_partner_earnings_v1.valid OR reporting_partner_earnings_v1.activity_date > olap_reporting_date()) AS earnings_exceptions,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM reporting_partner_settlements_v1
                  WHERE NOT reporting_partner_settlements_v1.valid OR reporting_partner_settlements_v1.status = 'Completed'::text AND (reporting_partner_settlements_v1.activity_date IS NULL OR reporting_partner_settlements_v1.activity_date > olap_reporting_date())) AS settlement_exceptions,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM reporting_partner_settlements_v1
                  WHERE reporting_partner_settlements_v1.status = 'Pending'::text AND reporting_partner_settlements_v1.activity_date IS NULL) AS undated_pending,
            ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(reporting_partner_capital_v1.net_movement), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
                   FROM reporting_partner_capital_v1) AS pool,
            ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(olap_repayments_analytics."Partner A Profit" + olap_repayments_analytics."Partner B Profit" - olap_repayments_analytics."Interest Paid"::numeric), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
                   FROM olap_repayments_analytics) AS allocation_residual
        ), amounts AS (
         SELECT p.partner_id,
            p.partner_name,
            p.partner_role,
            p.role_count,
            COALESCE(c.net_capital, 0::numeric) AS net_capital,
                CASE
                    WHEN p.role_count = 1 AND q.earnings_exceptions = 0 AND q.capital_exceptions = 0 THEN COALESCE(e.interest_earned, 0::numeric)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS interest_earned,
                CASE
                    WHEN p.role_count = 1 AND q.earnings_exceptions = 0 AND q.capital_exceptions = 0 THEN COALESCE(e.expenses, 0::numeric)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS expenses,
            COALESCE(s.completed, 0::numeric) AS completed,
            COALESCE(s.pending, 0::numeric) AS pending,
            COALESCE(s.reserved, 0::numeric) AS reserved,
            COALESCE(s.pending_count, 0::bigint) AS pending_count,
            q.capital_exceptions,
            q.earnings_exceptions,
            q.settlement_exceptions,
            q.undated_pending,
            q.pool,
            q.allocation_residual
           FROM partners p
             LEFT JOIN capital c USING (partner_id)
             LEFT JOIN earnings e USING (partner_id)
             LEFT JOIN settlements s USING (partner_id)
             CROSS JOIN quality q
        ), final AS (
         SELECT a.partner_id,
            a.partner_name,
            a.partner_role,
            a.role_count,
            a.net_capital,
            a.interest_earned,
            a.expenses,
            a.completed,
            a.pending,
            a.reserved,
            a.pending_count,
            a.capital_exceptions,
            a.earnings_exceptions,
            a.settlement_exceptions,
            a.undated_pending,
            a.pool,
            a.allocation_residual,
            a.interest_earned - a.expenses AS net_earned,
                CASE
                    WHEN a.pool > 0::numeric AND a.capital_exceptions = 0 AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                       FROM amounts
                      WHERE amounts.net_capital < 0::numeric)) THEN a.net_capital / a.pool
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS capital_share,
            a.role_count = 1 AND a.capital_exceptions = 0 AND a.earnings_exceptions = 0 AND a.settlement_exceptions = 0 AS ready
           FROM amounts a
        )
 SELECT partner_id,
    partner_name,
    partner_role,
    role_count,
    net_capital,
    interest_earned,
    expenses,
    completed,
    pending,
    reserved,
    pending_count,
    capital_exceptions,
    earnings_exceptions,
    settlement_exceptions,
    undated_pending,
    pool,
    allocation_residual,
    net_earned,
    capital_share,
    ready,
    net_earned - completed AS unpaid,
        CASE
            WHEN ready THEN net_earned - reserved
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS available,
    reserved - completed - pending AS other_reserved,
        CASE
            WHEN ready THEN 'Ready'::text
            ELSE 'Needs review'::text
        END AS quality_status,
    (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text) AS queried_at
   FROM final f;

relations.name: reporting_partner_settlements_v1
relations.comment: R044 complete read-only settlement projection including future/undated Pending reservations and retained Cancelled audit rows. No contact or bank details.
relations.view_definition:
SELECT s."Row ID" AS settlement_id,
    s."Ref Partner" AS partner_id,
    p."Partner Name" AS partner_name,
    p."Partner Role" AS partner_role,
    s."Transfer Date" AS activity_date,
    s."Amount"::numeric AS amount,
    s."Status" AS status,
        CASE
            WHEN s."Status" = 'Completed'::text THEN s."Amount"::numeric
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END AS completed_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN s."Status" = 'Pending'::text THEN s."Amount"::numeric
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END AS pending_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN s."Status" IS DISTINCT FROM 'Cancelled'::text THEN s."Amount"::numeric
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END AS reserved_amount,
    ((p."Partner Role" = ANY (ARRAY['A'::text, 'B'::text])) AND s."Amount" IS NOT NULL AND s."Amount"::numeric > 0::numeric AND (s."Status" = ANY (ARRAY['Completed'::text, 'Pending'::text, 'Cancelled'::text]))) IS TRUE AS valid,
        CASE
            WHEN s."Transfer Date" IS NULL THEN 'Date missing'::text
            WHEN s."Transfer Date" > olap_reporting_date() THEN 'Future transfer date'::text
            ELSE 'Dated'::text
        END AS date_status
   FROM "Settlements" s
     LEFT JOIN "Partners" p ON p."Row ID" = s."Ref Partner";

relations.comment: R044 current all-record partner entitlement. Net earned less all non-Cancelled reservations. Nullable safe availability, full-pool denominator, role uniqueness and global data-quality checks. Not cash liquidity.
relations.view_definition:
WITH partners AS (
         SELECT "Partners"."Row ID" AS partner_id,
            "Partners"."Partner Name" AS partner_name,
            "Partners"."Partner Role" AS partner_role,
            count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "Partners"."Partner Role") AS role_count
           FROM "Partners"
          WHERE "Partners"."Partner Role" = ANY (ARRAY['A'::text, 'B'::text])
        ), capital AS (
         SELECT reporting_partner_capital_v1.partner_id,
            sum(reporting_partner_capital_v1.net_movement) AS net_capital,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT reporting_partner_capital_v1.valid) AS invalid_count
           FROM reporting_partner_capital_v1
          GROUP BY reporting_partner_capital_v1.partner_id
        ), earnings AS (
         SELECT reporting_partner_earnings_v1.partner_id,
            sum(reporting_partner_earnings_v1.allocated_interest) AS interest_earned,
            sum(reporting_partner_earnings_v1.allocated_expense) AS expenses,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT reporting_partner_earnings_v1.valid OR reporting_partner_earnings_v1.activity_date > olap_reporting_date()) AS invalid_count
           FROM reporting_partner_earnings_v1
          GROUP BY reporting_partner_earnings_v1.partner_id
        ), settlements AS (
         SELECT reporting_partner_settlements_v1.partner_id,
            sum(reporting_partner_settlements_v1.completed_amount) AS completed,
            sum(reporting_partner_settlements_v1.pending_amount) AS pending,
            sum(reporting_partner_settlements_v1.reserved_amount) AS reserved,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE reporting_partner_settlements_v1.status = 'Pending'::text) AS pending_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT reporting_partner_settlements_v1.valid OR reporting_partner_settlements_v1.status = 'Completed'::text AND (reporting_partner_settlements_v1.activity_date IS NULL OR reporting_partner_settlements_v1.activity_date > olap_reporting_date())) AS invalid_count
           FROM reporting_partner_settlements_v1
          GROUP BY reporting_partner_settlements_v1.partner_id
        ), quality AS (
         SELECT ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM reporting_partner_capital_v1
                  WHERE NOT reporting_partner_capital_v1.valid OR reporting_partner_capital_v1.activity_date > olap_reporting_date()) AS capital_exceptions,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM reporting_partner_earnings_v1
                  WHERE NOT reporting_partner_earnings_v1.valid OR reporting_partner_earnings_v1.activity_date > olap_reporting_date()) AS earnings_exceptions,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM reporting_partner_settlements_v1
                  WHERE NOT reporting_partner_settlements_v1.valid OR reporting_partner_settlements_v1.status = 'Completed'::text AND (reporting_partner_settlements_v1.activity_date IS NULL OR reporting_partner_settlements_v1.activity_date > olap_reporting_date())) AS settlement_exceptions,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM reporting_partner_settlements_v1
                  WHERE reporting_partner_settlements_v1.status = 'Pending'::text AND reporting_partner_settlements_v1.activity_date IS NULL) AS undated_pending,
            ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(reporting_partner_capital_v1.net_movement), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
                   FROM reporting_partner_capital_v1) AS pool,
            ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(olap_repayments_analytics."Partner A Profit" + olap_repayments_analytics."Partner B Profit" - olap_repayments_analytics."Interest Paid"::numeric), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
                   FROM olap_repayments_analytics) AS allocation_residual
        ), amounts AS (
         SELECT p.partner_id,
            p.partner_name,
            p.partner_role,
            p.role_count,
            COALESCE(c.net_capital, 0::numeric) AS net_capital,
                CASE
                    WHEN p.role_count = 1 AND q.earnings_exceptions = 0 AND q.capital_exceptions = 0 THEN COALESCE(e.interest_earned, 0::numeric)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS interest_earned,
                CASE
                    WHEN p.role_count = 1 AND q.earnings_exceptions = 0 AND q.capital_exceptions = 0 THEN COALESCE(e.expenses, 0::numeric)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS expenses,
            COALESCE(s.completed, 0::numeric) AS completed,
            COALESCE(s.pending, 0::numeric) AS pending,
            COALESCE(s.reserved, 0::numeric) AS reserved,
            COALESCE(s.pending_count, 0::bigint) AS pending_count,
            q.capital_exceptions,
            q.earnings_exceptions,
            q.settlement_exceptions,
            q.undated_pending,
            q.pool,
            q.allocation_residual
           FROM partners p
             LEFT JOIN capital c USING (partner_id)
             LEFT JOIN earnings e USING (partner_id)
             LEFT JOIN settlements s USING (partner_id)
             CROSS JOIN quality q
        ), final AS (
         SELECT a.partner_id,
            a.partner_name,
            a.partner_role,
            a.role_count,
            a.net_capital,
            a.interest_earned,
            a.expenses,
            a.completed,
            a.pending,
            a.reserved,
            a.pending_count,
            a.capital_exceptions,
            a.earnings_exceptions,
            a.settlement_exceptions,
            a.undated_pending,
            a.pool,
            a.allocation_residual,
            a.interest_earned - a.expenses AS net_earned,
                CASE
                    WHEN a.pool > 0::numeric AND a.capital_exceptions = 0 AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                       FROM amounts
                      WHERE amounts.net_capital < 0::numeric)) THEN a.net_capital / a.pool
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS capital_share,
            a.role_count = 1 AND a.capital_exceptions = 0 AND a.earnings_exceptions = 0 AND a.settlement_exceptions = 0 AS ready
           FROM amounts a
        )
 SELECT partner_id,
    partner_name,
    partner_role,
    role_count,
    net_capital,
    interest_earned,
    expenses,
    completed,
    pending,
    reserved,
    pending_count,
    capital_exceptions,
    earnings_exceptions,
    settlement_exceptions,
    undated_pending,
    pool,
    allocation_residual,
    net_earned,
    capital_share,
    ready,
    net_earned - completed AS unpaid,
        CASE
            WHEN ready THEN net_earned - reserved
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS available,
    reserved - completed - pending AS other_reserved,
        CASE
            WHEN ready THEN 'Ready'::text
            ELSE 'Needs review'::text
        END AS quality_status,
    (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text) AS queried_at
   FROM final f;

relations.name: reporting_partner_settlements_v1
relations.comment: R044 complete read-only settlement projection including future/undated Pending reservations and retained Cancelled audit rows. No contact or bank details.
relations.view_definition:
SELECT s."Row ID" AS settlement_id,
    s."Ref Partner" AS partner_id,
    p."Partner Name" AS partner_name,
    p."Partner Role" AS partner_role,
    s."Transfer Date" AS activity_date,
    s."Amount"::numeric AS amount,
    s."Status" AS status,
        CASE
            WHEN s."Status" = 'Completed'::text THEN s."Amount"::numeric
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END AS completed_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN s."Status" = 'Pending'::text THEN s."Amount"::numeric
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END AS pending_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN s."Status" IS DISTINCT FROM 'Cancelled'::text THEN s."Amount"::numeric
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END AS reserved_amount,
    ((p."Partner Role" = ANY (ARRAY['A'::text, 'B'::text])) AND s."Amount" IS NOT NULL AND s."Amount"::numeric > 0::numeric AND (s."Status" = ANY (ARRAY['Completed'::text, 'Pending'::text, 'Cancelled'::text]))) IS TRUE AS valid,
        CASE
            WHEN s."Transfer Date" IS NULL THEN 'Date missing'::text
            WHEN s."Transfer Date" > olap_reporting_date() THEN 'Future transfer date'::text
            ELSE 'Dated'::text
        END AS date_status
   FROM "Settlements" s
     LEFT JOIN "Partners" p ON p."Row ID" = s."Ref Partner";
